# philosophy

> > philosophy is a skincare and fragrance brand offering products like amazing grace, hope in a jar, purity made simple, and ultimate miracle worker.

philosophy combines skincare science with beauty philosophy, featuring signature collections including anti-aging treatments, cleansers, moisturizers, and layerable fragrances. The brand offers a philosophers rewards program and subscribe & save options for recurring delivery.
